blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Comedian Gil Aducal Morales, popularly known as Ate Gay, passed away on Sunday, Nov. 1, his family confirmed. He was 55. Morales’ family released the sad news two days after stating the comedian was in critical condition and relying on life support after suffering septic shock, acute respiratory failure secondary to pneumonia, and stroke.
